description: The LOCALE phrase of FUNCTION UPPER-CASE / LOWER-CASE (argument-1 LOCALE locale-name-1), ISO 15.97.2 / 15.57.2 - introduced 2014 (kb/Work PB4311): the printed 2002 formats of both functions are `( argument-1 )` with no phrase, and the 2009 CD that became the 2014 edition prints `[ LOCALE locale-name-1 ]` and lists it among the substantive changes not affecting existing programs (its D.3 items 9 and 23). The 2023 Annex A.4.9 items 13 / 6 name the phrase as part of the locale-support module; that is an optional-module list, not an introduction record. The phrase selects the case correspondence of the named locale's LC_CTYPE (15.97.4 r2 / 15.57.4 r2). The functions themselves are 1985 (the Intrinsic Function Module amendment); the SPECIAL-NAMES LOCALE clause that declares locale-name-1 is 2002 (special-names-locale-2002); the phrase is gated in the binder (IntrinsicBinder.BindCaseFunctionWithLocale) like the other function-argument introductions.
display: the LOCALE phrase of UPPER-CASE / LOWER-CASE
vcr: 2014 introduction (the 2009 CD's D.3 items 9 / 23; absent from the printed 2002 formats; kb/Work PB4311)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. PB64T5CPR.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
CONFIGURATION SECTION.
SPECIAL-NAMES.
    LOCALE TR IS "tr-TR".
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 S PIC X(4).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    MOVE FUNCTION UPPER-CASE("i" LOCALE TR) TO S.
    STOP RUN.
